title: Longest Palindromic Subsequence II
summary: Determine the length of the longest subsequence of a string that is a palindrome with an even length and no two consecutive characters being the same, except for the middle pair.
statement: Determine the length of the longest subsequence of a string that is a palindrome with an even length and no two consecutive characters being the same, except for the middle pair.
constraints: A good subsequence is an even-length palindrome with unequal consecutive characters except for its equal middle pair.
Return the maximum possible good-subsequence length; return zero when no pair exists.
hints: Record the outer character of each good palindrome, not just its length.
For equal endpoints c, wrap the best inner palindrome whose outer character is not c.
DP over intervals and 26 possible outer letters; also carry solutions from either smaller interval.
Wrapping adds an equal endpoint pair, and excluding the same inner outer character enforces every non-middle adjacency; every good palindrome decomposes this way.
editorial: Wrapping adds an equal endpoint pair, and excluding the same inner outer character enforces every non-middle adjacency; every good palindrome decomposes this way.

tests.explanation: The subsequence baab is a good palindrome of length four; its only equal adjacent letters are the middle pair.
The subsequence dccd has length four and satisfies the same adjacency rule.
